evidence.description: The initializer obtains authentication state directly from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared.
Profile updates directly access the shared authentication service again.
Visit registration retrieves its access token from the shared authentication service rather than an injected dependency.

candidates.explanation: The provider directly depends on the operational EcosiaAuthenticationService singleton for authentication state, profile information, and access tokens. Its initializer supplies only accountsProvider; the authentication service has no explicit replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: A mutable factory is exposed as nonisolated(unsafe), and the nonisolated shared initializer invokes it inside MainActor.assumeIsolated without establishing the executing actor.
Deinitialization uses MainActor.assumeIsolated to access observer instance state without a visible guarantee that deinitialization executes on the main actor.

candidates.explanation: The unsafe concurrency escapes support actual mutable-state access and initialization, rather than merely annotating declarations. The shared initializer assumes main-actor execution despite being nonisolated, and deinitialization similarly assumes isolation when reading observer state. No visible execution guarantee or synchronization establishes those assumptions.
candidates.title: Unjustified Unsafe Concurrency Escape Hatch
